published.en: Applications are admitted only within either of these UTC windows: at or after 2026-11-03T08:00:00.000Z but strictly before 2026-11-08T20:00:00.000Z; or strictly after 2026-11-12T16:00:00.000Z and at or before 2026-11-17T23:59:59.999Z. Within a window, an applicant qualifies if either (1) age is at least 14 but under 18, guardian consent is present, and the applicant is a resident or is both a student and not a member; or (2) age is at least 18, and the applicant is either a resident without a scholarship, or a student who satisfies at least one of these two conditions: being a member, or having no scholarship. All other applications are rejected. For admitted applicants only, use the first matching fee in this priority order, in USD cents: scholarship 1800; member 3600; age under 18 2900; student 4800; otherwise 6400. Rejected applicants have no fee.

alice.text: Applications are admitted only within either of these UTC windows: at or after 2026-11-03T08:00:00.000Z but strictly before 2026-11-08T20:00:00.000Z; or strictly after 2026-11-12T16:00:00.000Z and at or before 2026-11-17T23:59:59.999Z. Within a window, an applicant qualifies if either (1) age is at least 14 but under 18, guardian consent is present, and the applicant is a resident or is both a student and not a member; or (2) age is at least 18, and the applicant is either a resident without a scholarship, or a student who satisfies at least one of these two conditions: being a member, or having no scholarship. All other applications are rejected. For admitted applicants only, use the first matching fee in this priority order, in USD cents: scholarship 1800; member 3600; age under 18 2900; student 4800; otherwise 6400. Rejected applicants have no fee.

bob.text: Las solicitudes se admiten únicamente dentro de una de estas ventanas UTC: a partir de 2026-11-03T08:00:00.000Z, inclusive, pero antes de 2026-11-08T20:00:00.000Z, sin incluir ese instante; o a partir de 2026-11-12T16:00:00.000Z, inclusive, y hasta 2026-11-17T23:59:59.999Z, inclusive. Dentro de una ventana, se cumple el requisito si (1) la edad es de al menos 14 y menor de 18, hay consentimiento del tutor, y la persona es residente o es estudiante sin ser miembro; o (2) la edad es de al menos 18, y se cumple una de estas dos alternativas: ser residente sin beca, o ser estudiante y cumplir al menos una de estas condiciones: ser miembro, o no tener beca. Se rechazan todas las demás solicitudes. Solo para solicitudes admitidas, se aplica la primera tarifa que corresponda en este orden de prioridad, en centavos de USD: beca 1800; miembro 3600; edad menor de 18, 2900; estudiante 4800; en otro caso 6400. Las solicitudes rechazadas no tienen tarifa.
